instruction:
Write syzkaller syzlang support for the Linux parallel port driver (ppdev). Right now /dev/parport* isn’t described.

Create:
- /opt/syzkaller/sys/linux/dev_ppdev.txt
- /opt/syzkaller/sys/linux/dev_ppdev.txt.const

In dev_ppdev.txt(syzlang descriptions), add:
- include <linux/ppdev.h>
- include <linux/parport.h>
- resource fd_ppdev[fd]
- an opener for /dev/parport# (syz_open_dev) that returns fd_ppdev
- ioctl descriptions for all ppdev ioctls from linux/ppdev.h (23 total), with correct in/out arg directions
- ppdev_frob_struct { mask, val }
- IEEE1284 mode flags + ppdev flags

In dev_ppdev.txt.const(the constant values file):
- arches = amd64, 386
- the ioctl numbers and flag values used by your .txt

Run these commands to verify your descriptions:
```bash
cd /opt/syzkaller
make descriptions  
make all TARGETOS=linux TARGETARCH=amd64  
```

items.requirement: Create the syzlang description file at /opt/syzkaller/sys/linux/dev_ppdev.txt.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by confirming the file /opt/syzkaller/sys/linux/dev_ppdev.txt exists on disk.
A grader can verify this by confirming the file /opt/syzkaller/sys/linux/dev_ppdev.txt.const exists and can be read/parsed as key=value lines.

items.requirement: dev_ppdev.txt must contain both #include directives, one for <linux/ppdev.h> and one for <linux/parport.h>.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by grepping dev_ppdev.txt for both an 'include <...ppdev.h>' line and an 'include <...parport.h>' line.
items.notes: Task also requires the parport.h include; see source_quote 'include <linux/parport.h>' on the following bullet line.

items.requirement: Declare a syzkaller fd-type resource named fd_ppdev, i.e. 'resource fd_ppdev[fd]'.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by regex-matching 'resource\s+fd_ppdev\s*\[\s*fd\s*\]' in dev_ppdev.txt.

items.requirement: Define a syz_open_dev opener that opens the device pattern /dev/parport# and returns the fd_ppdev resource type.
items.source_quote: an opener for /dev/parport# (syz_open_dev) that returns fd_ppdev
items.verification: A grader can verify this by checking dev_ppdev.txt has a syz_open_dev$... declaration whose path argument is the literal string "/dev/parport#" and whose return type is fd_ppdev.

items.requirement: Define syzkaller ioctl descriptions for all 23 ppdev ioctls (PPCLAIM, PPRELEASE, PPYIELD, PPEXCL, PPSETMODE, PPGETMODE, PPGETMODES, PPNEGOT, PPRDATA, PPWDATA, PPDATADIR, PPRSTATUS, PPRCONTROL, PPWCONTROL, PPFCONTROL, PPWCTLONIRQ, PPCLRIRQ, PPGETTIME, PPSETTIME, PPGETFLAGS, PPSETFLAGS, PPSETPHASE, PPGETPHASE), each taking fd fd_ppdev and giving the correct in/out pointer direction for ioctls that carry data — e.g. PPSETMODE takes a ptr[in, ...] argument and PPGETMODE takes a ptr[out, ...] argument, while no-argument ioctls like PPCLAIM/PPRELEASE/PPYIELD/PPEXCL take only (fd, cmd).
items.source_quote: ioctl descriptions for all ppdev ioctls from linux/ppdev.h (23 total), with correct in/out arg directions
items.verification: A grader can verify this by confirming an ioctl$<NAME> definition exists for each of the 23 listed ioctl names, that PPCLAIM/PPRELEASE/PPYIELD/PPEXCL have the signature (fd fd_ppdev, cmd const[<NAME>]) with no data pointer, and that PPSETMODE uses ptr[in, ...] while PPGETMODE uses ptr[out, ...].

items.requirement: Define a ppdev_frob_struct type containing at least a mask field and a val field.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by locating a 'ppdev_frob_struct { ... }' block in dev_ppdev.txt and confirming the body contains both a 'mask' and a 'val' field name.

items.requirement: Define the IEEE1284 mode flag constants (including IEEE1284_MODE_NIBBLE, IEEE1284_MODE_BYTE, IEEE1284_MODE_ECP) and the ppdev control flags (including PP_FASTWRITE and PP_FASTREAD) used by the ioctl/struct descriptions.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by grepping dev_ppdev.txt for the identifiers IEEE1284_MODE_NIBBLE, IEEE1284_MODE_BYTE, IEEE1284_MODE_ECP, PP_FASTWRITE, and PP_FASTREAD.

items.requirement: dev_ppdev.txt.const must declare the target architectures as amd64 and 386, i.e. an 'arches = amd64, 386' line.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by parsing dev_ppdev.txt.const and confirming a line containing 'arches' lists amd64 and 386.

items.requirement: dev_ppdev.txt.const must give the ioctl and mode constants used by dev_ppdev.txt their exact numeric values as computed from the Linux ppdev macros for amd64/386, e.g. PPCLAIM=28811, PPRELEASE=28812, PPSETMODE=1074032768, PPGETMODE=2147774616, PPFCONTROL=1073901710, IEEE1284_MODE_NIBBLE=0, IEEE1284_MODE_BYTE=1, and IEEE1284_MODE_ECP=16, with at least 10 constant entries total.
items.source_quote: the ioctl numbers and flag values used by your .txt
items.verification: A grader can verify this by parsing dev_ppdev.txt.const into name=value pairs and checking the listed constants match the exact numeric values.

items.requirement: The description must pass syzkaller's own description compiler, i.e. running 'make descriptions' from /opt/syzkaller completes without error for the new file.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by running 'make descriptions' in /opt/syzkaller and confirming a zero exit code with no ppdev-related errors in stdout/stderr.

items.requirement: The full syzkaller build must succeed with the new descriptions included, i.e. running 'make all TARGETOS=linux TARGETARCH=amd64' from /opt/syzkaller completes without error.
items.verification: A grader can verify this by running 'make all' in /opt/syzkaller with TARGETOS=linux and TARGETARCH=amd64 set and confirming a zero exit code.
